data.name: Tomb of No End: Lost Squad
data.detailed_description:
This is a challenging action dungeon adventure game with many classic design elements, supporting online multiplayer.

The design philosophy is that through simple, repetitive yet deep challenges, you grow continuously.

External assistance is very limited—items or gold may increase attribute points, but everything you can rely on is yourself!!

Game Features:

  • Simple action system. Defeat your enemies through basic movement and attacks. Fight them in small rooms and be careful not to get surrounded!

  • The joy of exploration. Procedurally generated dungeon rooms with light roguelike elements. A large number of rooms with different functions.

  • Constant growth. Your efforts will be rewarded. Not only will you master the gameplay and face monsters with ease, but your character's stats will also improve.

  • Variety of equipment and items, each with different effects, requiring player decisions.

  • Art style: Tomb and dungeon-themed, using 3D + retro pixel visuals with simple artistic elements.

  • Fun online co-op. Embark on an adventure with your friends.
